ParabricksStepConfig.description:
Operator-tunable linear Align knobs (actionConfig.parabricks).

``engine=parabricks`` keeps NVIDIA Clara fq2bam_meth. ``engine=mojo`` uses
MojoFq2bamMeth in the mojo-align image (NVIDIA/AMD/CPU via align_device).

align_device.description: Mojo portable device when engine=mojo: auto|cpu|nvidia|amd. Operator-set per site/profile. Ignored for Clara.
align_device.title: Align Device

alignment_mode.description: Must be linear when this section is used for SamplePrep linear arm.
alignment_mode.title: Alignment Mode

bwa_threads.description: BWA / MojoFq2bamMeth CPU thread pool. Operator-set per site/profile.
bwa_threads.title: Bwa Threads

engine.description: Linear Align implementation: 'parabricks' (Clara fq2bam_meth, NVIDIA) or 'mojo' (MojoFq2bamMeth, portable). Operator-set per site/profile.
engine.title: Engine

gpu_flags.description: Docker GPU flags for Clara (e.g. '--gpus all'). Operator-set per site.
gpu_flags.title: Gpu Flags

image.description: Docker image for Align. Clara NGC tag when engine=parabricks; goliath/methylgrapher:1.70-mojo-cuda|rocm when engine=mojo.
image.title: Image

mojo_image.description: Optional override image when engine=mojo (else image or goliath/methylgrapher:1.70-mojo).
mojo_image.title: Mojo Image

reference_fasta.description: Linear GRCh38 FASTA path. Usually from site reference_genome.fasta.
reference_fasta.title: Reference Fasta

write_methylation_tags.description: When true, MojoFq2bamMeth writes XM:Z/XG:Z methylation tags (METHYLGRAPHER_WRITE_METH_TAGS). Operator-set per procedure/profile. Clara fq2bam_meth uses sequence+XG fallback when tags are absent.
write_methylation_tags.title: Write Methylation Tags

ParabricksStepConfig.title: ParabricksStepConfig

executionScopeId.description: Baked execution scope id from instance finalize (provenance).
executionScopeId.title: Executionscopeid

project.description: Legacy alias of projectPath from older input templates (provenance only).
project.title: Project

projectPath.description: Study project path for provenance/logging only; not a config source.
projectPath.title: Projectpath

resolvedConfig.description: Merged actionConfig.parabricks baked at instance configuration.
